studies.title: Native representation and identification limit
studies.training: 512 distinct input/action witnesses per address, selected by deterministic SHA order on inputs only; same selected inputs for all16 addresses within seed.
studies.evaluation: 1536 never-trained inputs/address, no query labels given to any learner. Dataset is deliberately constructed engineering truth, not external causality.
studies.mechanisms: Addresses0..3 degree1,4..7 degree2,8..11 degree3,12..15 degree5. Each generated sparse GF2 composition has3 distinct highest-degree terms and2 distinct lower-degree terms where available, selected only by SHA(seed,address,mask). Family identity/coefficients never given to fit APIs.
studies.order: Complete degree11 basis first, then5,3,2,1. All48 fixed source datasets reused across model-class arms; no post-result retuning.
studies.controls: Independent lowest-pivot set-XOR symbolic solver with same degree/data; fully trained sklearn CART(gini,max_depth=None,min_samples_split=2,min_samples_leaf=1,ccp_alpha=0,random_state=seed); retrieval-only. CART fit once/dataset and exact-source reused across degrees.
studies.metrics: Representability,rank,feature count,correct/incorrect/abstain on1536 unseen combinations,independent exact-control parity, train/infer walltime. Report basis assumptions, sample/capacity/compute differences.
studies.threshold: Complete basis should abstain on all unseen input rows at512 witnesses. At degree3, all representable degree<=3 source datasets must fit and predict all unseen correctly if full rank; degree5 data rejected as model-class inadequacy. If any claim fails preserve negative rather than tune.

studies.title: Native learned-state persistence after subsequent training

studies.threshold: All old predictions byte-identical, cold outputs exact; no training events in compact checkpoint.

studies.title: Bounded representation repair, not outcome rewriting

studies.budget: One address/model-class change per seed, at most3 seeds/3 targeted edits. No corrected source labels, no edits from heldout answers, no accepting stochastic contradiction as a false source fact.
studies.threshold: Fixed unseen accuracy/coverage restored under declared degree3 assumption; previous slots unchanged. Strong symbolic control expected tie; scientific_pass staysfalse.
